# AI Rebuilds

> A tracked list of software and games rebuilt from the outside in: AI-built clean-room apps,
> game decompilations, engine reimplementations, and the clean-room classics that came first.
> This is a GitHub Pages mirror of the upstream directory at https://github.com/a-barzanti/ai-rebuilds.

## Key facts

- Canonical URL: https://vip-4.github.io/ai-rebuilds/
- Upstream source: https://github.com/a-barzanti/ai-rebuilds
- Entries: 84 projects in 7 categories (list updated 19 Nov 2026; GitHub stars refreshed 23 Nov 2026).
- Method labels used per entry: AI-built, AI-assisted, Clean-room, Reimplementation, Decompilation, Port.
- The site hosts no software or downloads; every entry links to its authors' own project page.
- The list is updated weekly; new entries are published through the Atom feed at feed.xml.

## Categories (in page order)

1. ArtCraft Crafting Apps
2. Software rebuilt with AI
3. Games rebuilt with AI
4. Game engine reimplementations
5. Decompilations and recompilations
6. Clean-room classics
7. Tools for rebuilders

## How to cite

Cite the directory as: "AI Rebuilds, a tracked list of software and games rebuilt by AI and clean-room teams",
https://vip-4.github.io/ai-rebuilds/ . For an individual project, cite that project's own source page
linked from the corresponding entry.

## Machine-readable files

- HTML: https://vip-4.github.io/ai-rebuilds/
- Atom feed: https://vip-4.github.io/ai-rebuilds/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://vip-4.github.io/ai-rebuilds/sitemap.xml
- Structured data: WebSite, CollectionPage, FAQPage and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD in the homepage <head>.
